hero.label: Oversight
hero.title: Continuous Monitoring & Governance
hero.desc: Active oversight mechanisms that ensure compliance, protect stakeholders, and maintain operational integrity across your entire platform deployment.

features.title: Operational Monitoring
features.text: Real-time monitoring of platform operations, compliance status, and key performance indicators. Automated alerts for anomalies and threshold breaches.

features.title: Reporting & Dashboards
features.text: Customizable dashboards showing compliance status, operational metrics, and audit readiness. Scheduled report generation for management and regulators.

features.title: Governance Framework
features.text: Multi-party approval workflows, role-based access control, and separation of duties. Every action logged with who, what, and when.

features.title: Alerting & Incident Response
features.text: Configurable alerting rules for compliance breaches, operational anomalies, and security events. Documented incident response procedures.

info_blocks.title: Governance by Design
info_blocks.intro: CCASH platforms are built with governance as a first-class concern:
items: Role-Based Access: Granular permissions control who can view, create, approve, or modify each resource
Multi-Party Approvals: Sensitive operations require independent authorization from multiple roles
Immutable Audit: Every action is logged with cryptographic integrity guarantees
Separation of Duties: The people who propose changes cannot be the same people who approve them
Configurable Workflows: Approval chains adapt to your operational structure, not the other way around

info_blocks.title: Operational Controls
info_blocks.intro: CCASH deployments provide comprehensive operational oversight:
items: Real-time monitoring of all platform services and compliance status
Automated compliance checks on every transaction and operation
Scheduled and on-demand report generation for regulatory requirements
Configurable alert thresholds with email, webhook, and in-app notifications
Documented incident response procedures with automated escalation

info_blocks.title: Multi-Party Controls
info_blocks.intro: No single person can make critical changes unilaterally:
items: Multiple approvers required: Sensitive operations need sign-off from independent keyholders
Recorded decisions: Every approval is logged with an immutable audit trail
Separation of duties: The people who propose changes aren't the same people who approve them
info_blocks.outro: This isn't bureaucracy for its own sake. It's protection against insider threats, compromised accounts, and honest mistakes.
